description: An HF night through the V4's upconverter: WSJT-X works the bands and writes ALL.TXT, Siuti watches the log (a file-watch - Siuti does not decode FT8 itself), and the 915 MHz sensors check in between. On a Blog V3 the same plan works, with HF heard by direct sampling and weaker below 14 MHz.
name: hf-night
